_comment: Per-target limits for macos-qemu. Copied to /etc/deputyos/limits.json at bake time. Schema lives in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. See docs/14-limitations.md §'macos-qemu' for the source-of-truth narrative. This is a DEMO-ONLY target — the qcow2 boots in UTM (Apple Silicon) or OrbStack/qemu (Intel) with TCG emulation.

limitations.reason: macos-qemu is a try-it-out target. QEMU TCG emulation on macOS hosts (especially Intel) throttles guest CPU 5-10x vs native; not suitable for production agent workloads.
limitations.unblock: Run deputyOS on real hardware: rpi5 8GB+, x86_64-mini-pc, or a cloud target (digitalocean / oracle-arm-free).

limitations.reason: QEMU on macOS does not pass /dev/snd reliably; CPU throttling makes wake-word detection unworkable even if it did.
limitations.unblock: rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for on-device voice.

limitations.reason: 2 GB RAM allocation + emulated CPU make even 1B Q4 models unworkably slow.
limitations.unblock: rpi5 8GB+ for 1B local; x86_64-mini-pc for 3B local; or cloud providers.

limitations.reason: clamd RSS (~900 MB) exceeds the 2 GB launcher default; on-demand clamscan + Magika is used instead.
limitations.unblock: Increase the qemu memory allocation in run-utm.sh / run-orbstack.sh, or use rpi5 8GB+.

limitations.reason: There is no A/B partition on a qcow2 demo image; rollback is host-snapshot of the qcow2 file.
limitations.unblock: Production targets (rpi5, x86_64-mini-pc, digitalocean) have proper A/B or snapshot rollback.

limitations.reason: Apple Neural Engine and Apple Silicon GPU are not exposed inside QEMU/UTM guests.
limitations.unblock: Run native macOS apps for Apple-Silicon-accelerated inference; deputyOS targets Linux.

limitations.reason: WhatsApp Cloud webhook RSS exceeds the 2 GB low-tier headroom.
limitations.unblock: rpi5 8GB+, x86_64-mini-pc, or a cloud target.
